llm_response.reason: The site uses typosquatting to impersonate the well-known steamrep.com reputation checker, closely resembles the legitimate service’s design, and urges visitors to sign in with Steam credentials. This closely matches scam characteristic #16 (spoofing legitimate sites) and #3 (targeting human psychology). The domain lacks public trust references, has no visible legitimate ownership, and was recently registered. These factors, combined with the intent to harvest Steam logins, indicate a phishing/technical support scam.
